item.description: The AsyncResultBuilder._send method incorrectly handles StopIteration exceptions when dealing with async generators. The method raises StopIteration inappropriately instead of properly converting it to a return value, causing "Task got bad yield" errors. Additionally, the async result builder doesn't properly handle awaitable values like Result objects when they are yielded.
item.contract: When an async generator yields a Result value, the AsyncResultBuilder._send method should properly await the Result and return the unwrapped value. When a StopIteration exception occurs (either normally or due to RuntimeError conversion), it should be properly converted to a return value instead of being re-raised.

item.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder._send method has similar issues to AsyncResultBuilder with StopIteration handling and incorrect processing of awaitable values. It also fails to properly handle the "Nothing" case when awaiting async Option values.
item.contract: When an async generator yields an Option value, the AsyncOptionBuilder._send method should properly await the Option and return the unwrapped value. When a StopIteration exception occurs, it should be properly converted to a return value instead of being re-raised.

item.description: The SeqBuilder._send method incorrectly tries to handle async generators in a synchronous context, leading to attribute errors. It also has issues with proper StopIteration handling that causes assertion failures in tests.
item.contract: The SeqBuilder._send method should correctly process generators in a synchronous context without attempting to call async-specific methods like __anext__(). It should properly handle StopIteration exceptions to return appropriate values.

item.description: The base Builder._send method has incorrect handling of StopIteration for async generators, and the overall flow in the __call__ method doesn't properly handle the case where StopIteration is raised during initial send or subsequent processing.
item.contract: The base Builder._send method should correctly differentiate between StopIteration with values vs StopIteration without values, and should properly handle async generators by detecting them and dispatching to the appropriate handling logic.

item.description: The AsyncResultBuilder._send method has issues with handling exceptions when awaiting values. Specifically, TypeError: exceptions must derive from BaseException errors occur when trying to raise exceptions that are not valid exception instances.
item.contract: When awaiting a Result that raises an exception in the async context, the AsyncResultBuilder should properly handle the exception and convert it to an Error result rather than raising invalid exceptions.
